timeline.summary: Pradeep Kumar Kheruka, on behalf of Borosil Limited’s promoters, declared no encumbrance on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹284.12 Cr (+5.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10.59 Cr (-4.9% YoY).
Borosil Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 & FY26 results on May 22, 2026, via its website.
Borosil held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, outlining upcoming flask manufacturing commencement and solar savings.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹369.8 Cr (+8.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.91 Cr (+40.5% YoY).
